subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw display the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move it to Settings, or keep config-path discovery CLI/config-page only?
rationale: The technical implementation is narrow, but the linked request leaves placement open and the PR makes an absolute local path prominent in the UI.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this presentation-only approach after real Control UI proof confirms the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings
options.body: Ask for the same field to be shown in a Settings or Config information area instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI/Config Only
options.body: Decline this UI exposure point and rely on the existing config command or config-page workflows for path discovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this presentation-only approach after real Control UI proof confirms the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview view structure that would receive the visible row.
